title: Integral tail signatures and the Hilbert--Smith conjecture
summary: The obstruction to an effective $p$-adic manifold action is an integer signature tail. On asymptotically controlled rational modules over one fixed free $C_p$-space, finite-cover Mayer--Vietoris makes the difference between $p$ copies and quotient-permutation tensoring nilpotent. Every degree-four class therefore has eventually $p$-divisible signatures.
